excerpt.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]欢迎你们加入星海帝国，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你现在已经成为了比[Root.GetName]更伟大事物的一部分。
excerpt.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] welcomes you to the Galactic Imperium, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You are now part of something far greater than the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]欢迎你们加入星海帝国，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你现在已经成为了比[Root.GetName]更伟大事物的一部分。
texts.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] welcomes you to the Galactic Imperium, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You are now part of something far greater than the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 星海帝国已经展现了他们的强大力量。认清事实，继续抵抗是徒劳的，拥抱你的未来成为帝国的子民吧。
texts.en: The Galactic Imperium has demonstrated its might. Accept the futility of continued resistance, and embrace your future as Imperial citizens.

texts.zh: 很好。一切都如同[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]所预见的那样进行着。
texts.en: Good. Everything is proceeding as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has foreseen.
